name: sshi_fbr_res
rationale: The previous SSHI FBR design delivered sufficient power (vavg > 1.8V) but suffered from high output ripple (vpp) and slow settling (dv) on marginal conditions (S2, S4). The ripple is dominated by the high-energy charge bursts transferred from Cp to the storage capacitor C1 during the synchronous flip. Adding a small series resistor (R_smooth) between the rectifier output and the storage capacitor limits these peak currents, reducing vpp without significantly increasing the DC settling time (since R_smooth << RL).
